content: लालाटिक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [ललाटं प्रभोर्भालं पश्यति ठञ्] .²1 Being on or relating to the forehead. .²2 Arising from or dependent on fate; प्राप्तिस्तु लालाटिकी <ls>Udb.</ls> .²3 Useless, low, vile. .²4 Attentive, vigilant. .{@-कः@} .²1 An attentive servant (<ab>lit.</ab> one who watches his masterʼs countenance and learns by it what is necessary to be done). .²2 An idler, a careless or useless person. .²3 A kind of embrace.
